snippet.title: DigWorld Trailer
snippet.description:
DigWorld is a cozy 2D digging extraction sandbox, where each run is a race against the clock to get the best rewards. Collect as many items as you can before time runs out. Sell. Upgrade. Repeat.

Steam page: store.steampowered.com/app/4567230/DigWorld/
